WITH SensorMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.containlink, 
        MAX(sd.tempdevcount) AS max_tempdevcount, 
        MAX(sd.critevents) AS max_critevents, 
        MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_tempstabidx, 
        -- Assuming 'alertkind' contains status information
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sd.alertkind, ', ') AS sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        SensorData sd
    GROUP BY 
        sd.containlink
),
ContainerMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry, 
        c.coolremainpct, 
        -- Assuming 'coolremainpct' is the coolant percentage remaining
        sm.max_tempdevcount, 
        sm.max_critevents, 
        sm.max_tempstabidx, 
        sm.sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        Container c
    LEFT JOIN 
        SensorMetrics sm ON c.containregistry = sm.containlink
),
RiskMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.containregistry, 
        cm.coolremainpct, 
        cm.max_tempdevcount, 
        cm.max_critevents, 
        cm.max_tempstabidx, 
        cm.sensor_data_status, 
        -- Assuming 'Container Risk Index (CRI)' is a known external metric
        EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('ContainerRiskIndex', cm.containregistry) AS cri, 
        -- Assuming 'Temperature Breach Severity (TBS)' is a known external metric
        EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('TemperatureBreachSeverity', cm.containregistry) AS tbs, 
        -- Assuming 'Risk Rank' is a known external metric
        EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('RiskRank', cm.containregistry) AS risk_rank
    FROM 
        ContainerMetrics cm
),
FinalResults AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.containregistry AS container_id, 
        rm.max_tempstabidx AS max_temp_stability_score, 
        rm.cri AS container_risk_index, 
        rm.risk_rank, 
        rm.sensor_data_status, 
        JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'TempDevCount', rm.max_tempdevcount,
            'CritEvents', rm.max_critevents,
            'TempStabIdx', rm.max_tempstabidx,
            'CoolRemainPct', rm.coolremainpct,
            'TempBreachSeverity', rm.tbs
        ) AS diagnostic_summary
    FROM 
        RiskMetrics rm
)
SELECT 
    container_id, 
    max_temp_stability_score, 
    container_risk_index, 
    risk_rank, 
    sensor_data_status, 
    diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    FinalResults
ORDER BY 
    risk_rank DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH SensorMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.containlink, 
        MAX(sd.tempdevcount) AS max_tempdevcount, 
        MAX(sd.critevents) AS max_critevents, 
        MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_tempstabidx, 
        -- Assuming 'alertkind' contains status information
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sd.alertkind, ', ') AS sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        SensorData sd
    GROUP BY 
        sd.containlink
),
ContainerMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry, 
        c.coolremainpct, 
        -- Assuming 'coolremainpct' is the coolant percentage remaining
        sm.max_tempdevcount, 
        sm.max_critevents, 
        sm.max_tempstabidx, 
        sm.sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        Container c
    LEFT JOIN 
        SensorMetrics sm ON c.containregistry = sm.containlink
),
RiskMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.containregistry, 
        cm.coolremainpct, 
        cm.max_tempdevcount, 
        cm.max_critevents, 
        cm.max_tempstabidx, 
        cm.sensor_data_status, 
        -- Assuming 'Container Risk Index (CRI)' is a known external metric
        EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('ContainerRiskIndex', cm.containregistry) AS cri, 
        -- Assuming 'Temperature Breach Severity (TBS)' is a known external metric
        EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('TemperatureBreachSeverity', cm.containregistry) AS tbs, 
        -- Assuming 'Risk Rank' is a known external metric
        EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('RiskRank', cm.containregistry) AS risk_rank
    FROM 
        ContainerMetrics cm
),
FinalResults AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.containregistry AS container_id, 
        rm.max_tempstabidx AS max_temp_stability_score, 
        rm.cri AS container_risk_index, 
        rm.risk_rank, 
        rm.sensor_data_status, 
        JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'TempDevCount', rm.max_tempdevcount,
            'CritEvents', rm.max_critevents,
            'TempStabIdx', rm.max_tempstabidx,
            'CoolRemainPct', rm.coolremainpct,
            'TempBreachSeverity', rm.tbs
        ) AS diagnostic_summary
    FROM 
        RiskMetrics rm
)
SELECT 
    container_id, 
    max_temp_stability_score, 
    container_risk_index, 
    risk_rank, 
    sensor_data_status, 
    diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    FinalResults
ORDER BY 
    risk_rank DESC
LIMIT 10;
